comment.body: Thanks for describing the prerequisite download followed by an elevation prompt and a standard-user install that could not continue. The install scope matters because a per-user install may not need elevation, while a machine-wide install does. Could you confirm which scope you selected and whether a current PowerToys setup still downloads prerequisites before that elevation prompt? This will avoid changing the wrong installer flow.

proposed_fixes.title: Resolve install scope before downloading machine-wide prerequisites
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Installer may download prerequisites before determining whether requested scope needs elevation.
plan: Determine per-user vs per-machine scope before fetching scope-specific prerequisites.
For machine-wide install, request consent before avoidable downloads where supported.
Keep per-user install available without unnecessary elevation.
verification: Machine-wide users see elevation decision before avoidable downloads; per-user path unchanged.
